pathr 0.1.0
  • Get started
  • Reference

Frictionless file paths in R and RStudio. On Windows, every path is a small chore: backslashes R will not accept, a file explorer you keep switching to, and the same steps repeated for every file. pathr is a handful of tools, mostly RStudio addins, that take those chores away.

It grew out of daos and stands alone: it depends on neither daos nor the data-wrangling stack daos brings along, so it installs light enough to have in every session.

Installation 

pak::pak("dataniel/pathr")

What it looks like

Copy several files in the explorer (Ctrl+Shift+C, Copy as path), paste, select, and run the Text to vector addin:

"C:\data\2026\jan.csv"            c(
"C:\data\2026\feb.csv"     ->       "C:/data/2026/jan.csv",
                                    "C:/data/2026/feb.csv"
                                  )

Or never leave R. browse_files() is a keyboard-driven file browser: mark files with Space, press Enter, and the paths, or a call that reads them, land in your script.

p <- browse_files()    # navigate, mark with Space, press Q

Functions

Function Description
browse_files() Yazi-style Shiny file browser: mark files/folders and copy paths, or a call that reads them, to R
open_in_explorer() Open a folder, or reveal a file, in the system file explorer
addin_open_in_explorer() RStudio addin: open the selected path, the path under the cursor, or getwd() in the file explorer
addin_paste_path() RStudio addin: paste Windows paths from the clipboard as a quoted R string or a c(...) vector
addin_fix_path() RStudio addin: replace backslashes with forward slashes in Windows paths
addin_flip_backslash() RStudio addin: replace all backslashes with forward slashes in the selection
addin_text_to_vector() RStudio addin: convert selected lines, such as Copy as path output, to an R character vector

Call the addins from the Addins menu or the command palette (Ctrl+Shift+P), or bind them to a shortcut under Tools -> Modify Keyboard Shortcuts. vignette("pathr") walks through all of it.
